name: Annabidiol Corp.
summary: Annabidiol Corp. presently lacks substantial ongoing business operations. Although it previously engaged in the telecommunications industry, the company's current strategy emphasizes pursuing asset acquisitions, cultivating strategic alliances, initiating joint ventures, and collaborating with various firms. Founded in 2009, the entity was initially known as Asiana Dragons, Inc. before officially rebranding to Annabidiol Corp. in January 2018. Its corporate headquarters are located in Marblehead, Massachusetts.
